title: Domains
description: Register the domains your workspace controls. TXT record verification proves ownership, and it is what enables asset discovery.

states.error: The domains could not be loaded.
states.emptyDescription: Add a domain and publish the TXT record we will show you. Discovery is not possible without verification.

verify.MATCH: Domain verified. You can now run asset discovery.
verify.MISMATCH: The record exists but the value does not match. Check that you pasted the full value, without quotes.
verify.NO_TXT: The name exists but has no TXT record. Add it and wait for it to propagate.
verify.NXDOMAIN: That name does not exist in DNS. Check that the domain is spelled correctly.
verify.TIMEOUT: DNS did not respond. Wait a few seconds and try again.
verify.ERROR: The name server returned an error. Try again in a moment.

conflict.ESTE_WORKSPACE: This domain is already registered in your workspace.
conflict.OTRO_WORKSPACE: This domain is already registered by another organization.
conflict.CARRERA: Another request registered this domain at the same time. Refresh the list.

errors.create: The domain could not be registered.
errors.verify: The TXT record could not be checked.
errors.delete: The domain could not be deleted.

dialog.domainHint: Without scheme or trailing slash. It is stored in lower case.
dialog.methodDnsHint: Recommended. You publish a record and the platform checks it.
dialog.methodHttpHint: Not available yet. DNS verification is what has been implemented.
dialog.instructionsLead: One step left to take control of {{domain}}: publish this record in its DNS zone and verify again.
dialog.recordNameHint: The "name" or "host" field at your provider. The domain is appended automatically.
dialog.recordValueHint: Paste it exactly as it is, without quotes. It is the proof that you control the domain.
dialog.propagationHint: DNS changes can take a few minutes depending on the provider. Once your panel says it is published, press "Verify now".
